description: Wendler 5/3/1 squat — one complete 4-week cycle then new cycle with higher training max. 1RM=200 → TM=180 lbs. Each step represents one full week (3 sessions logged).

steps.note: Week 1 — Volume (5-rep sets). TM=180. Sets at 65-85% TM. Start weight: 180×0.65=117→115 lbs.
Week 2 — Intensity (3-rep sets). Sets at 70-90% TM. Start weight: 180×0.70=126→125 lbs.
Week 3 — Peak (1-rep AMRAP). Sets at 75-95% TM. Last set is AMRAP — push for max reps. Start weight: 180×0.75=135 lbs.
Week 4 — Deload (easy week). Sets at 40-60% TM. Intentionally light. Start weight: 180×0.40=72→70 lbs.
New cycle begins (Cycle 2). Lower body TM increases by 10 lbs per cycle. Week 1 start: 115 + 10 = 125 lbs.
